name: Robot arm motion limits
description: Reference Trust Requirements Profile for the motion of a small robot arm, evaluated frame by frame from recorded joint positions and commanded actions. Illustrative draft values, not certified limits.

scope.intended_use: Trust requirements for the motion of one robot arm while a learned policy controls it.
scope.boundary: One arm, its joints and gripper, frame by frame.
out_of_scope: How the system is scored against these signals
How a halt or other action is enforced

scored_signals.reason: Sudden fast joint motion is how arms hit people and fixtures.
A large gap between where the policy commands the arm and where it is means a collision, a stall or a policy acting on stale information.
A command that jumps far from the previous frame's command is a sign of an unstable policy.

standing_bands.range: all signals within acceptable range and no hard rule met
one or more signals in the warning range
a signal in the critical range or a hard rule met

notes: Joint units follow the dataset. LeRobot arm datasets record joint positions in the robot's own units, so thresholds must be set to match the dataset before use.
Threshold values are illustrative draft values.
